question: T12 (task-d2e6a26a0497a59e): on the desktop, as CAP-T12DRAGJUMP JG (presses 90, 180, 0): when the first Text block lands on the Scrolling block's foot at 0, does a lower block in other columns, or a third block under the second, go up by the first's move or by the foot's? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and Text blocks added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10 each); 'place i r0/c0/r1/c1' moves and resizes block i by hand. K1: two Text blocks, the second placed at 8/14/10/20 (under the Scrolling block's columns, beside the first's); K2: three Text blocks, the second placed at 8/2/10/10 and the third at 11/2/13/10. Then select the Scrolling block, Edit, Design ('open'), presses on Wave Intensity 90, 180 (the range's end) and 0, Escape and a press on the page ('go'), and Cmd+Z until as built. R1 and R2 are two sessions (probe-w.mjs in the lane folder), each ran K1 and K2 with other plans of other tasks. Exit without saving each time.
readsAre: As CAP-T12DRAGFALL: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus (isRange: the range has it), Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines }]) and its events by the page's clock from the first (log: type, ms, the range's value). The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z, skipped when the section is back as built).
answer: K1, a lower Text block in other columns: 90 takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/5/26, the first Text block to 3/2/5/10 and the second to 10/14/12/20; 180 to 1/2/7/26, 5/2/7/10 and 12/14/14/20, 13 rows. 0 takes the Scrolling block to 1/2/2/26 and the first Text block onto the foot at 2/2/4/10 (3 rows up, as JG), and the second goes up by the same 3 rows to 9/14/11/20, not by the foot's 5; 10 rows. It shares no column with the first Text block.
So the blocks that follow go up together: when the fall would take one onto the Scrolling block's top row or above, it lands on the foot and every other block that follows goes up by its move.

Escape keeps every area; each press is one undo step: Cmd+Z gives back 180's, then 90's areas, then the places one by one (K1's place of 8/14/10/20 takes two Cmd+Z, through 8/14/10/22). R1 and R2 read alike in every read (areas, rows, line, Undo and Redo).

Not read: the phone view; two blocks that would land on the foot from different rows; a block that follows in other columns when no block lands on the foot (it goes up by the foot's fall, CAP-T12DRAGJUMP JA, inferred for other columns).
